description: The plot illustrates layer-wise relative change for several token/precision configurations (LB-Avg and RULER4k) compared against a constant baseline across five grouped layer ranges. The x-axis is categorical with five tick labels—Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32—spaced evenly. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 5%, 0%, −5%, −15%, and −25%, spanning approximately −25% to 5%. A gray dashed horizontal baseline labeled “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit” lies at 0% across all x-axis categories. The yellow solid line with circular markers (“LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”) stays close to 0%, starting around 0% at Layer1-4, remaining near 0% at Layer5-12, dipping to about −2% at Layer13-20, returning to about 0% at Layer21-28, and ending slightly above 0% at Layer29-32. The red solid line with square markers (“LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”) starts at about 0% at Layer1-4, moves to roughly −1% at Layer5-12, drops to about −5% at Layer13-20, rises to around −2% at Layer21-28, and ends near 0% at Layer29-32. The light blue solid line with circular markers (“RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”) begins around −2% at Layer1-4, is near −2% at Layer5-12, falls to about −13% at Layer13-20, rises to roughly −2% at Layer21-28, and ends around −1% at Layer29-32. The dark blue solid line with square markers (“RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”) starts near −3% at Layer1-4, is around −4% at Layer5-12, reaches about −25% at Layer13-20, increases to roughly −6% at Layer21-28, and ends near −3% at Layer29-32.
caption_used: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, employing SnapKV as the pruning method with a KV cache budget of 1/64. The line plot depicts relative change across five layer groupings (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32) on the x-axis, with the y-axis representing relative change from -25% to 5%. The yellow line (LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit) remains approximately stable near 0% throughout, exhibiting a minor dip to roughly -3% at Layer13-20 before stabilizing. The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit) demonstrates a gradual decline, reaching nearly -10% at Layer13-20, then recovering to approximately -2% by Layer29-32. The light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit) declines sharply to -18% at Layer13-20, subsequently rebounding to around -5% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit) collapses to -25% at Layer13-20, then rapidly recovers to -8% by Layer29-32. The gray dashed baseline (4×tokens, 4-bit) remains constant at 0% across all layers. Notably, the RULER4k configurations consistently underperform relative to LB-Avg configurations, with the 8-bit variants exhibiting more pronounced volatility than their 16-bit counterparts across middle layers.
